items.name: Ledgerwall Porters
items.art_brief: Stocky debt laborer behind a tall riveted ledger shield with a brass tally rack; short hook hammer and thick leather apron.
items.gameplay_rationale: Cheap defensive anchor now rewards Defend with brace retaliation and staggers attacking survivors, preparing the faction volley chain. Low damage preserves the laborer role.

abilities.name: Riveted Ledgerwall
abilities.description: Cheap riveted plates blunt incoming ranged fire without adding battle-line punch.

abilities.name: Unpaid Balance
abilities.description: While defending, answer melee attackers with 10% stronger retaliation and leave survivors staggered for one round; defending also adds one cohesion.

items.name: Writwheel Reclaimers
items.art_brief: Lean masked loader carrying an oversized toothed brass disc launcher, stacked debt writs and a spring drum across the back.
items.gameplay_rationale: Opening ranging disc staggers one surviving target per battle, creating rather than merely consuming the faction stagger payoff.

abilities.name: Stamped Ricochet
abilities.description: A hard-cranked tally disc skips through a staggered line with a little more force than its cheap spring should carry.

abilities.name: Served by Ricochet
abilities.description: Once per battle, the first surviving target is staggered for one round, losing one initiative and opening it to calibrated volleys.

items.name: Seambreaker Hounds
items.art_brief: Low armored mechanical hound with forked seam-prying jaws, riveted shoulder plates and twin dorsal pressure vents.
items.gameplay_rationale: Faster cooperative armor opener; two supported exposures per battle give a second attack window without becoming a solo assassin.

abilities.name: Rivet Hide
abilities.description: Low-slung plating screens the pack from arrows but does not improve its bite.

abilities.name: Seambreaker Mandibles
abilities.description: Twice per battle, striking a surviving tier-two-or-higher target beside an allied stack exposes two defense for one round.
abilities.support_blocked_summary: Seambreaker Mandibles need an allied stack beside the target.
abilities.support_ready_summary: Seambreaker Mandibles will expose two defense for the supported follow-up.

items.name: Arrestor Spoolers
items.art_brief: Industrial cable worker with a huge shoulder reel and weighted copper arrestor loops; cold quench canister and broad braced stance.
items.gameplay_rationale: Adds a once-per-battle anti-melee initiative disruption and a rooted mark that opens Foreclosure Engine Seizure Clause. The cable does not prevent movement; it prepares the collection attack without overlapping arbalist counterbattery suppression.

abilities.name: Quenchspool Redline
abilities.description: A redline cable cast lands with furnace force against a line already staggered by the opening exchange.

abilities.name: Arrestor Cable
abilities.description: Once per battle, a surviving melee target of tier two or higher is marked Cable-Arrested for one round, losing one initiative and becoming vulnerable to Seizure Clause. This mark does not prevent movement.

items.name: Kilnwall Wardens
items.art_brief: Two furnace attendants behind a monumental iron kiln-door pavis with orange glowing slots, thick side braces and soot-dark masks.
items.gameplay_rationale: Turns a specialist linebreaker screen into a general engine bodyguard: allied shooters and shielded stacks take less contact damage, while the expensive slow wall retains weak offense.

abilities.name: Kilnwall Engine Screen
abilities.description: The kiln-door wall blunts incoming missiles and reduces contact melee damage against allied shooters and shielded stacks by 8%, plus 6% against attackers with brace or reach.

items.name: Datumline Piercers
items.art_brief: Long precision arbalest on a shoulder support with a tall calibrated sight fork, brass measuring rails and a narrow armored gunner.
items.gameplay_rationale: Counterbattery alternative to the pavis: one ranged enemy loses defense and initiative, while bolts gain a new payoff against hound seam marks and overheated targets.

abilities.name: Datumline Solution
abilities.description: Measured bolts strike harder at range two or more, benefit from an allied defending stack, and deal 16% extra damage to seam-exposed or overheated targets.

abilities.name: Counterbattery Writ
abilities.description: Once per battle, a surviving ranged target of tier two or higher loses one defense and two initiative for one round.

items.name: Twinboiler Fusiliers
items.art_brief: Paired rounded pressure boilers rise behind a masked fusilier holding a wide multi-nozzle rivet gun; asymmetric valves and braided feed pipes.
items.gameplay_rationale: Artillery now reaches a secondary enemy up to two hexes from the victim, punishing loose formations as well as adjacent clusters. Single-secondary and heat limits remain.

abilities.name: Twinboiler Fragment Fan
abilities.description: Each shot throws bounded fragment damage into one enemy within two hexes of the primary target; the crew overheats for two rounds and loses one initiative.

items.name: Warrant Anvils
items.art_brief: Heavy armored bailiff with a rectangular pressure-gauge shield and massive stamped clause hammer; iron docket chains hang at the waist.
items.gameplay_rationale: Two retaliations and a stagger-producing brace make an anti-swarm anvil; it feeds gunline stagger bonuses rather than retaining the base rooting behavior.

abilities.name: Warrant Served
abilities.description: While defending, retaliations hit 18% harder and stagger survivors for one round, reducing initiative by two and cohesion by one; defending adds two cohesion.

abilities.name: Gaugeplate Screen
abilities.description: The numbered plate turns incoming shot aside while the bailiff closes under measured pressure.

items.name: Foreclosure Engines
items.art_brief: Hulking furnace automaton with a giant claw press, docket chains and an exposed red-orange chest boiler; heavy forward-leaning shoulders.
items.gameplay_rationale: Turns a generic burst attacker into the finisher of supported seam attacks. One-round heat cycle changes its attack cadence; no clean-target blanket multiplier increase.

abilities.name: Accelerated Foreclosure
abilities.description: A fresh furnace impact deals 16% extra damage, then the engine overheats for one round: damage falls to 83%, defense by two and initiative by two.

abilities.name: Seizure Clause
abilities.description: Primary melee strikes deal 15% extra damage to seam-exposed or rooted targets; the engine gains no extra momentum from this clause.

items.name: Staybell Bombardiers
items.art_brief: Bell-mouth mortar on a short wheeled carriage with a cooling cistern, broad iron braces and a hooded bell-ringer attendant.
items.gameplay_rationale: Replaces a small initiative debuff with a once-per-battle anti-retaliation writ, strongest against braced lines; its opening enables melee engines instead of merely duplicating artillery fragments.

abilities.name: Quenchbell Salvo
abilities.description: A held firing interval lets the mortar crew sound a calibrated long-range opening salvo.

abilities.name: Stay of Reprisal
abilities.description: Once per battle, a surviving shot target loses one cohesion and 10% retaliation damage for one round; a braced target of tier three or higher instead loses two cohesion and 20% retaliation damage.

items.name: Redline Crucible Crawlers
items.art_brief: Low six-legged furnace gun platform with a long red pressure rail, twin molten vents and a broad armored crucible belly.
items.gameplay_rationale: High-tier barrage gains one adjacent fragment target and a heat cycle, creating direct Saint repair synergy while retaining stagger exploitation. It trades mobility for siege support.

abilities.name: Crucible Barrage
abilities.description: The crawler braces for a furnace-driven barrage that tears hardest through already-staggered battle lines.

abilities.name: Redline Slag Burst
abilities.description: Each shot throws up to four fragment damage per crawler, capped at sixteen, into one adjacent enemy of the primary target; the crawler overheats for two rounds and loses one initiative.

items.name: Saint of the Last Furnace
items.art_brief: Towering living brass forge idol crowned with crucible ladles; open chest furnace, hanging repair-chain halo and massive soot-black hands.
items.gameplay_rationale: Changes the defense aura from heat-gated to always-on for allied Brasshollow stacks, supporting the entire mixed army; extra repair still rewards heat management and never revives casualties.

abilities.name: Last Furnace Covenant
abilities.description: All allied Brasshollow stacks gain one defense even when cool. Each round repairs surviving allies for 1.5% of starting health, plus 2% while overheated, without reviving casualties.
